info.title: three.ws 3D
info.description: Text-to-3D and image-to-3D generation returning GLB models, plus a 3D asset pipeline: auto-rigging, remeshing, game-ready retopology, geometric stylizing, background removal, model inspection, remixing, and talking avatar bodies.
info.x-guidance: Call an endpoint without payment to receive an x402 challenge, pay it in USDC on Solana mainnet, and retry with the payment header. Asynchronous 3D jobs return a token to poll for free at GET /api/forge?job=<token>.

post.summary: Generate a 3D model (GLB) from a text prompt or photos
post.description: Generate a textured GLB mesh from one text prompt or up to six reference photos of one object. Tiers: draft (fast, low-poly), standard (default), high (PBR textures). Returns a job token to poll for free.

schema.description: Provide exactly one of prompt (text->3D) or image_urls (image->3D). tier and aspect_ratio are optional; tier defaults to "standard".

prompt.description: Describe one subject for text->3D. Omit when supplying image_urls.

image_urls.description: Up to 6 public https reference views of one object for image->3D. Omit when supplying a prompt.

tier.description: Quality/price tier: draft $0.05 (low-poly), standard $0.15 (default), high $0.50 (PBR textures). The 402 quotes the price for the requested tier.

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the synthesized reference view for text->3D.

example.prompt: a brass steampunk owl, full body

400.description: Missing or invalid input. Refused before any payment settles.

402.description: Payment Required: an x402 challenge payable in USDC on Solana mainnet.

get.summary: Fetch the status and GLB URL of a 3D generation job
get.description: Poll a generation or pipeline job without payment. Returns status (queued, running, done, failed), per-stage progress for pipelines, and the GLB URL once the job is done.

parameters.name: job
parameters.description: Job token returned by a paid generation or pipeline call.

200.description: Result as JSON. No payment required.

post.summary: Submit a chained 3D job: generate, rig, remesh, stylize
post.description: Run an ordered chain of 3D stages (generate, rig, remesh, gameready, stylize) in one paid call. The 402 quotes the sum of the requested stages. Returns a job token to poll for free.

stages.description: Ordered subsequence of ["generate","rig","remesh","gameready","stylize"]. generate must be first and requires prompt; without generate, glb_url is required.

prompt.description: Subject for the generate stage. Required when stages starts with generate.

glb_url.description: Public https GLB to feed the first stage when the chain does not start with generate.

options.description: Per-stage options keyed by stage: tier and aspect_ratio for generate, rig_type for rig, remesh settings, gameready topology and poly_budget, stylize style and resolution.

example.prompt: a brass steampunk owl, full body

400.description: Missing or invalid input. Refused before any payment settles.

402.description: Payment Required: an x402 challenge payable in USDC on Solana mainnet.

post.summary: Convert a static GLB mesh into a rigged, animatable model
post.description: Infer a skeleton for a static GLB and bind it with skin weights so the model can walk, wave, and emote. Returns a durable URL to the rigged GLB.

glb_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the static .glb mesh to rig.

rig_type.description: Skeleton to infer: biped (humanoid, the default) or quadruped.

400.description: Missing or invalid input. Refused before any payment settles.

402.description: Payment Required: an x402 challenge payable in USDC on Solana mainnet.

post.summary: Convert a GLB mesh to a new topology and face count
post.description: Retopologize a GLB as triangles, quads, or low-poly, with repair and decimation to a target face count, and re-bake the texture onto the new mesh. Returns a durable GLB URL.

glb_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the source .glb mesh.

remesh_mode.description: Output topology: triangle (default), quad, or lowpoly.

operation.description: full (default) remeshes and re-bakes; simplify, repair, or convert run one step only.

target_faces.description: Target face count for the output mesh, 1,000 to 500,000.

texture_size.description: Edge length in pixels of the re-baked texture.

400.description: Missing or invalid input. Refused before any payment settles.

402.description: Payment Required: an x402 challenge payable in USDC on Solana mainnet.

post.summary: Convert a GLB into a game-ready mesh under a poly budget
post.description: Retopologize a GLB to a fixed polygon budget (quad or silhouette-preserving triangles) with PBR textures re-baked onto the new topology, ready for a game engine. Returns a durable GLB URL.

glb_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the source .glb mesh.

poly_budget.description: Maximum polygon count of the output mesh, 1,000 to 500,000.

texture_size.description: Edge length in pixels of the re-baked PBR textures.

400.description: Missing or invalid input. Refused before any payment settles.

402.description: Payment Required: an x402 challenge payable in USDC on Solana mainnet.

post.summary: Convert a GLB mesh into voxel, brick, shatter, or low-poly
post.description: Rebuild a GLB geometrically in a voxel, brick, Voronoi-shatter, or faceted low-poly style. The style lives in the mesh, not a shader, so it survives export to any engine.

glb_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the source .glb mesh.

style.description: Geometric style: voxel (default), brick, voronoi, or lowpoly.

400.description: Missing or invalid input. Refused before any payment settles.

402.description: Payment Required: an x402 challenge payable in USDC on Solana mainnet.

post.summary: Remove the background from an image for image-to-3D
post.description: Strip the background from an image and return a transparent PNG, the clean reference view image-to-3D reconstruction needs. Returns a durable PNG URL.

image_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the source image (PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or GIF).

model.description: Segmentation model to use; rmbg2 (default) suits most objects.

get.summary: Analyze a GLB model and return stats and optimization tips
get.description: Fetch a public glTF or GLB and return structural stats (vertices, triangles, materials, textures, animations, extensions) with a prioritized list of optimization recommendations.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Public HTTPS URL of a glTF/GLB model.

post.summary: Create a remix of a published 3D model from an instruction
post.description: Generate a new 3D model from a published remixable source and a plain-language change. Records parent-to-child provenance and routes the creator royalty on-chain.

source_creation_id.description: The id of a remixable creation (from GET /api/remix-feed).

instruction.description: The change to make, in plain language: "make it metallic", "bigger helmet", "add a cape".

example.instruction: make it matte black with gold trim

400.description: Missing or invalid input. Refused before any payment settles.

402.description: Payment Required: an x402 challenge payable in USDC on Solana mainnet.

get.summary: Browse remixable 3D models and their royalty terms
get.description: List published 3D models that accept remixes, with their GLB and preview URLs, royalty percentage, and remix count. Use a returned id as source_creation_id for a paid remix.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of remixable models to return.

200.description: Result as JSON. No payment required.

post.summary: Create a rigged, talking 3D avatar body for an AI agent
post.description: Create a rigged, animated, voiced 3D avatar from a prompt or a photo. Returns the agent id, GLB URL, viewer and profile URLs, and an HTML embed. Failed generations are not charged.

name.description: Display name for the avatar and its agent profile.

prompt.description: Appearance of the avatar in plain language. Give this or image_url.

image_url.description: Public photo of the subject to build the avatar from. Give this or prompt.

personality.description: Optional persona text the avatar speaks and behaves from.

voice.description: Optional voice id for the avatar's speech.

example.name: Nova Scout
example.prompt: a friendly explorer in a teal jumpsuit
